acceptance_walk:
I walked this on bench "review-l4-github-link": the daemon on 49070, the UI on 2670 and the stand-in GitHub on 49071, all started from my worktree on fix/l4-github-link at fac9519 with --provider bench. I seeded the repositories through the stand-in GitHub's API only (no git commands). bench/seeded's main got Kite club's marker and doc set. Its old fr/docs-scaffold branch (cae5c98) got a third project's marker, and that branch's pull request #1 was closed without merging. My walk scripts are in the scratchpad (review-l4link-walk.cjs, review-l4link-settings.cjs, review-l4link-long.cjs, seed*.mts). Screenshots and texts are in /tmp/frbench/review-l4-github-link/steps/.

(1) L4-github-101 and 102. New project "Kite flyers" on bench/seeded showed the offer: 'bench/seeded is already the Forerunner project "Kite club" ... Work together / Take it over' (01-rv-a1-offer). I pressed Take it over. GitHub then had exactly one open pull request, #2 on fr/docs-scaffold-kite-flyers. Its body ends with 'This repository was the Forerunner project "Kite club"; it is now the project "Kite flyers".' and the hidden mark. fr/docs-scaffold stayed at cae5c98 and #1 stayed closed (review-a.json). The Overview showed no take-over line, which is right because the take-over landed (02-rv-a2-overview.png). It did list the pull request as '"The project's docs from the plan" · pull request #2' (see non-blocking). Docs showed 8 of 8 present and no repository line (rv-docs). On Changes I pressed Undo on 'Created the project Kite flyers'; the row became 'Kite flyers (removed)' (rv-b3). New project "Kite flyers again" with a brief on the same repository showed the same offer again ('Works on "Kite club" too and plans your brief as its new work.' / Take it over), and no project was made (08-rv-b4-offer-again.png).

(2) L4-github-102, push refused. bench/refused2's main names "Glider club", and I added a pre-receive hook that refuses every push. New project, Take it over: no pull request opened. The Overview (18-rv-r2-overview.png) and the Docs tab above '8 of 8 present' (19-rv-r3-docs.png) both read 'Took over bench/refused2 from "Glider club" here, but the docs pull request that names this project could not be opened, so GitHub still names "Glider club".'

(3) L4-github-103. Work together on bench/seeded made "Kite club". Its Overview says 'Shared on GitHub with another Forerunner: each keeps its own tasks.' and each Docs row says who writes it. Settings with Advanced open has 'Who merges accepted work' for Kite club and no 'Status pull request' row (rv-c5-settings-advanced). In chat, 'tool: settings_set {"key":"status_pull_request","value":true}' answered 'Refused: You work on "Kite club" together with another Forerunner, so its status stays in the app (Docs, Status); no status pull request is opened.' (rv-chat-status-pr).

(4) L4-github-109. On bench/longname, whose marker name is 61 characters, the lines under the buttons were 98 and 99 characters without a brief, and 95 and 99 with one. Each cut the name at a word with an ellipsis (rv-l1/l2-long-offer).

Work keeps going by itself where it must: nothing in this area starts or stops sessions. I stopped the bench with scripts/bench/stop.mjs and deleted its home, the stand-in GitHub's data and the browser profile.

non_blocking: Seen on the bench in the acceptance journey: the Overview lists the take-over's docs pull request on fr/docs-scaffold-kite-flyers as '"The project's docs from the plan" · pull request #2' (02-rv-a2-overview.png). That is wrong, because there was no plan. The cause is packages/runtime/src/daemon/pull-requests.ts:72 docsTitle, which recognises only DOCS_SCAFFOLD_BRANCH. pull-requests.ts belongs to l4-github-merge, and the fixer handed this over in notes_for_other_areas. The session lead must make sure docsTitle uses isScaffoldBranch at the L4e merge, otherwise this ships.

The no-pull-request take-over line on the Overview and Docs gives no next step (design section 5 rule 8): canTakeOver is false, nothing in the app tries the docs pull request again, and the only way out (Undo on Changes) is not mentioned. The user guide also says the line shows 'until that pull request is on GitHub'. In fact scaffoldLeftNoMarker reads only summary_cache.docs, so a pull request opened by hand does not clear it; only a merged marker on main or the Undo does.

Sibling not listed: a take-over made with a brief (intake: true) defers its docs to the intake. If the intake's docs pull request then fails, the Overview says nothing, because without a scaffold record scaffoldLeftNoMarker is false.

DocsTab shows any 'elsewhere' line, not only the take-over one. For example OR-07's 'o/kite is also the Forerunner project ...' appears there without its Take it over button, which repeats the Overview (design section 5 rule 10).

intakeDocsBranch keeps '..' from a project name, as taskBranchName already does: safeSegment allows dots, so 'Wait... what' gives fr/intake-xxxxxxxx-wait...-what-docs, which git refuses. scaffoldBranchesOf already replaces dots. This class already exists in task branches.

The offer's first sentence still shows the marker name cut at 60 characters in the middle of a word ('... of the lower lake distric"', bench rv-l1-long-offer). This comes from markerNameOf, is pre-existing, and is not the line L4-github-109 fixed.

rebuildForTakeOver writes the branch's version of every file the branch changed since its merge-base. If main later changed the same file, main's newer version is replaced by the branch's older one. Rare.

After Undo of a successful Take it over, the removed project's docs pull request (#2) stays open on GitHub. The next Take it over opens a second pull request that also replaces the marker. This is by design (run C decision 14), but the person could merge the wrong one.

Two concurrent first-plan POSTs are not refused atomically: pendingFor is checked before the model call. Without the removed existingPr path, the second approval would push over the first's open intake branch and createPullRequest would fail. Unlikely through the UI.
The writing-rules sweep only catches the `"${x}"'s` and `quoted(...)}'s` forms. It misses other helpers, e.g. a future `${quote(x)}'s`. Drop the join-words.ts exclusion once L4-github-113 is merged.
